candidates.classification: executed public-data teaching and exploratory workflow; not promoted to research use

data.attribution: International Telecommunication Union (ITU), World Telecommunication/ICT Indicators Database, via World Bank World Development Indicators.
data.observation: Individuals who used the Internet in the preceding three months; an annual measure of current use, not cumulative first adoption.

limits: Real observations and retained native execution support an executable teaching example.
The November 2026 vintage makes the split retrospective, not an as-of-2015 real-time forecast evaluation.
Repeated cutoff exploration is exploratory; recent Internet use is not cumulative first adoption or evidence of a causal diffusion mechanism.
The inspected sources explicitly describe a teaching/exploratory lesson; this dossier does not reclassify it as an accepted research study.

next_evidence: A factual research-use record from the existing research owner: research question, actual Innovate revision/artifact, source/environment, input provenance/rights, executed commands, outputs and publication/analysis linkage. Historical Python use must remain separate from native 0.7 qualification.
limits: The search was bounded and public-only; no claim of worldwide absence of research use is made.
No private mail, Drive, workbooks or analysis folders were accessed; no one was contacted.
No examples, synthetic checks, intended integrations, source citations or package downloads were counted as research adoption.
No authorship, human review, funding, rights, editorial or submission attestation is generated.
